categories.main_business_segments: The company operates four main business segments: optical electronics (optical films and functional membranes for displays), photovoltaic (solar backsheets, gap reflective films, and encapsulation films), automotive (window films), and battery (PC flame-retardant films and lithium battery materials). The optical electronics segment is the core business, with photovoltaic products representing a rapidly growing segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core competencies include proprietary precision coating technology, formula design, and coating process expertise. Key production methods include precision coating equipment with self-designed key coating stations, micro-replication and engraving processes at international advanced levels, and composite film bonding technology. The company has developed independent equipment modification capabilities and integrates multiple coating techniques on single equipment platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include leading display panel manufacturers, photovoltaic component manufacturers (such as Jinko, Longi), and automotive manufacturers. End markets include LCD televisions, computer monitors, smartphones, tablets, photovoltaic modules, and automotive applications. The company serves both domestic Chinese customers and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major facilities in Ningbo (Zhejiang Province) and Anhui Province. International presence includes subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Shanghai, Singapore, and Malaysia. Domestic sales account for 78.87% of revenue while international sales represent 21.13%, with significant exposure to Malaysia and Vietnam markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures functional films and membranes that are supplied to display panel manufacturers, photovoltaic component manufacturers, and automotive companies. The company sources raw materials from suppliers and sells finished products to downstream manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: maintaining leadership in optical films while expanding into high-end display technologies (Mini-LED, quantum dot films, COP); rapid development of photovoltaic products (backsheets, gap reflective films, encapsulation films); expansion into flexible display materials (OCA optical adhesives); and development of environmentally friendly products (0-VOC diffusion films, PCR-based films). R&D focuses on next-generation display technologies and new energy applications.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of optical films, photovoltaic films, window films, and encapsulation films. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of products, either upon receipt and acceptance or upon product withdrawal from designated warehouses. The company also generates minor revenue from waste material sales and equipment rental.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In optical films, the company competes with international leaders including 3M (USA) and Japanese, Korean, and Taiwan-based manufacturers. The company positions itself as a domestic leader with advanced technology and quality comparable to international standards. In photovoltaic films, the company is a newer entrant but has rapidly gained market share with leading component manufacturers. The company emphasizes technological innovation and product quality as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 2.175 billion yuan, down 5.55% from 2023's 2.303 billion yuan. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 190.11 million yuan, up 31.67% year-over-year. Total assets were 3.683 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company shows strong profitability growth despite revenue decline, with operating cash flow of 347.95 million yuan, up 106.13% year-over-year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: superior coating technology and process expertise enabling high-quality, complex composite films; rapid new product development and commercialization capabilities; comprehensive product portfolio addressing multiple display and photovoltaic applications; strong customer relationships with leading manufacturers; and commitment to environmental sustainability through eco-friendly product development. The company emphasizes technical innovation, product quality, and responsive customer service as core value propositions.
